import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_8/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_8/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["Mouse ID", "Mouse ID"]
# Join df0 and df1 on "Mouse ID"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Target schema: ['Drug': string, 'Timepoint': integer, 'Mouse ID': integer]
# From df_joined, select and reorder columns to match target schema
# Convert "Timepoint" and "Mouse ID" to integer type
# "Drug" is string, keep as is

# First, ensure "Mouse ID" can be converted to integer
# From source examples, "Mouse ID" in source0 is string like 'n763', 'q787', 'y163'
# But target schema expects integer Mouse ID.
# We need to convert "Mouse ID" to integer.
# Since source "Mouse ID" is string with letters and digits, we must extract digits only.

# Extract digits from "Mouse ID" string to convert to integer
df_joined["Mouse ID"] = df_joined["Mouse ID"].astype(str).str.extract('(\d+)').astype(int)

# Convert "Timepoint" to integer (should already be integer, but enforce)
df_joined["Timepoint"] = df_joined["Timepoint"].astype(int)

# Select columns in target schema order
df_target = df_joined[["Drug", "Timepoint", "Mouse ID"]]

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_8/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_8/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_8/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Mouse ID
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Group by Drug and Timepoint (leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema)
# Aggregate Mouse ID by min to get integer Mouse ID (target Mouse ID is integer)
result = joined.groupby(["Drug", "Timepoint"], as_index=False).agg({"Mouse ID": "min"})

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
result = result[["Drug", "Timepoint", "Mouse ID"]]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_8/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
